title: Green triangles near LAX are airliner bokeh

tellings.quote: Also, the triangular, all the shows show these triangular green-shaped UAPs near LAX. They're not.

plain: The green triangle-shaped lights filmed near Los Angeles International Airport are not mystery craft but airliners, blurred by the camera into shapes, according to the skeptic researcher Michael Shermer. He tells Michels in a debate that 'all the shows show these triangular green-shaped UAPs near LAX', using UAP, the official term for unidentified objects in the sky, and then says, 'They're not.' His point is that a well-known piece of footage has an ordinary explanation: bokeh, the out-of-focus shapes a lens makes of bright lights.
